ticket.title: chalkline docs check does not validate SPEC symbol tables against the AST
ticket.description: docs check reports 0 drifted for a repository whose SPEC symbol table named a non-existent module, called an enum a struct, and listed a removed type (see GB-134). A cheap addition: parse the '| **Symbol** | kind | module |' rows and resolve each name/kind against the miter index or a source scan.

verification_receipt.summary: Closed on chalkline main at 7147ba2 + 800180f, developed on feat/chalkline-spec-contract-audit with the lease taken before any edit. The audit was impossible as specified because parse_contracts_from_markdown was a stub returning an empty vector: spec_contracts now parses the format render_markdown emits (contract heading plus field table, header and separator rows skipped), and docs::spec_symbols::audit_spec_declared_contracts reports any declared contract that WorkspaceInventory::public_types no longer defines, gated by the existing enforce_public_type_contracts policy. Four tests cover the round-trip format, prose declaring nothing, a retired contract drifting, and a spec in step with the AST. Separately, 7147ba2 repaired two pre-existing gate failures that made no chalkline commit pass Tier 2: the lib test module expect() under the expect_used deny lint, and rustfmt drift across six modules. Gates: fmt clean, clippy --workspace --all-targets -D warnings clean, nextest 17/17 core.
